records.source: A receptacle of unknown origins...
records.translation: 一個來歷不明的容器……

records.source: It's a strange relic from another world.
records.translation: 這是一件來自另一個世界的奇異遺物。

records.source: I don't have the chops to catch squid, but that's fine. I'll just cheer you on from here, kid.
records.translation: 我沒那本事釣魷魚，但沒關係。孩子，我就在這裡替你加油。

records.source: After a while, you get a feel for the squid's behavior. You can tell when one's on the line before you even see it.
records.translation: 釣久了，你就會摸清魷魚的習性。甚至還沒看見，就知道有一隻上鉤了。

records.source: I'm glad you fixed up the bus! This is really fun.$h#$e#I've always wanted to travel beyond Pelican Town.
records.translation: 真高興你修好了公車！這裡真的很好玩。$h#$e#我一直都想去鵜鶘鎮以外的地方旅行。

records.source: I was thinking of joining you in the skull caves, but then I saw the food stand...#$e#You go on ahead without me... just be careful!
records.translation: 我本來想和你一起去骷髏洞穴，但後來看見了小吃攤……#$e#你自己先去吧……千萬要小心！

records.source: Hey... you look really cute in the desert sun...$h
records.translation: 嘿……沙漠陽光下的你真可愛……$h

records.source: Hey, don't forget to pick up our free cactus before the festival ends.#$b#Whatever it looks like, it's gonna be perfect in our house!$h
records.translation: 嘿，別忘了在節慶結束前領取我們的免費仙人掌。#$b#不管它長什麼樣，放在我們家一定很完美！$h

records.source: Hey, I'll just stay here and relax in the shade.#$e#You know how I am... I've always been more of a cave dweller.$h
records.translation: 嘿，我就待在這裡，在陰涼處放鬆一下。#$e#你知道我的個性……我向來更像個洞穴住民。$h

records.source: Remind me to brush my teeth tonight... there's twelve unique soda flavors, and I'm on track to try them all.#$e#Mmm... cave carrot soda... *slurp*
records.translation: 今晚記得提醒我刷牙……這裡有十二種獨特口味的汽水，而我打算全部喝過一遍。#$e#嗯……洞穴蘿蔔汽水……*吸溜*

records.source: Well well well, what have we here? A beautiful desert rose!$h#$e#Make sure to stay watered, dear.
records.translation: 哎呀，看看我發現了什麼？一朵美麗的沙漠玫瑰！$h#$e#親愛的，記得多補充水分。

records.source: Hey, @. I'll be working late during the festival, so don't wait up for me at night!#$e#Promise me you'll be careful in the skull caves.
records.translation: 嘿，@。節慶期間我要工作到很晚，所以晚上別等我了！#$e#答應我，在骷髏洞穴裡一定要小心。

records.source: Hey, @! I love you just the way you are... but if you want, you can step inside the box too!
records.translation: 嘿，@！我愛你原本的模樣……不過你願意的話，也可以走進箱子裡！

records.source: I've been having fun, but I'm so busy I haven't been able to do any chores at home. I hope you're doing okay!
records.translation: 我玩得很開心，但實在太忙，家事一件也沒做。希望你一切都好！

records.source: I can't remember... did I feed the parrot this morning?
records.translation: 我想不起來了……今天早上有餵鸚鵡嗎？

records.source: Hey... looks like someone's got a nice tan going... *pinch*$h
records.translation: 嘿……看來某人曬出了漂亮的膚色……*捏*$h

records.source: %Your wife is taking a nap.
records.translation: %你的妻子正在小睡。

records.source: Hi, honey. I'm just browsing to see if there's anything nice for the house.$h
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的。我只是在逛逛，看有沒有適合家裡的好東西。$h

records.source: How's the Calico Egg collection coming along? There's so many cool prizes!$h#$e#I know you'll do great.
records.translation: 卡利科蛋收集得如何？這裡有好多酷炫的獎品！$h#$e#我知道你會有好表現。

records.source: I wanted to go swimming, but apparently the water's full of scorpion carp!$h
records.translation: 我本來想去游泳，但水裡似乎全是蠍鯉！$h

records.source: Have you seen the size of these Calico Eggs?#$b#Just imagine the protein...
records.translation: 你見過這些卡利科蛋有多大嗎？#$b#想想裡面有多少蛋白質……

records.source: This weather is just perfect. I can't tell where my skin ends and the air begins.$h
records.translation: 這天氣真是完美。我都分不清皮膚與空氣的界線了。$h

records.source: Hey, @. To tell you the truth, I don't really like festivals.#$b#But I'd feel even worse if I stayed at home, knowing that everyone else was out here having fun.$s
records.translation: 嘿，@。老實說，我不太喜歡節慶。#$b#但明知大家都在這裡開心玩樂，自己卻待在家裡，感覺只會更糟。$s

records.source: Why do humans enjoy spicy food? It's counter-intuitive from a biological perspective.#$e#Unless there's something I'm missing...$5
records.translation: 人類為什麼喜歡辛辣食物？從生物學角度來看，這有違直覺。#$e#除非我漏掉了什麼……$5

records.source: *mumble* ...hmm, the toe-feel is milky, but with plenty of body. Still, a bit mellower than back home...#$b#Oh, pardon me! I've become something of a sand connoisseur.$h
records.translation: *喃喃自語*……嗯，腳感如奶油般滑順，質地卻相當厚實。不過，比家鄉的稍微溫和些……#$b#噢，失禮了！我已經快成為沙子鑑賞家了。$h

records.source: Hmm... I'm sensing that your fashion doesn't quite match your inner feeling. Just step in the box and we'll fix you up!
records.translation: 嗯……我感覺你的穿著不太符合內心感受。只要走進箱子裡，我們就能替你改造！

records.source: Ah... the sands of time, the sands of time...
records.translation: 啊……時間之沙，時間之沙……

records.source: What is she mumbling about? I'm here for the spicy food tent!
records.translation: 她在嘀咕什麼？我是為了辛辣美食帳篷來的！

records.source: Normally I provide all the food for town festivals. But not today! It's nice to be able to relax.$h
records.translation: 平常鎮上辦節慶，所有食物都由我供應。但今天可不是！能放鬆一下真好。$h

records.source: If you smell something good, it's the coconut oil I rubbed all over my skin.#$b#I'm going 'all in' with the desert feeling!$h
records.translation: 如果聞到什麼香味，那是我擦遍全身的椰子油。#$b#我要全心投入沙漠風情！$h

records.source: %Haley is glistening in the sunlight.
records.translation: %海莉在陽光下閃閃發亮。

records.source: Going into the caves can be really dangerous. I hope there are no accidents, but still... I'll be here all day just in case.#$e#As a doctor, I'd recommend minimizing your exposure to serpent-infested caverns! But ultimately, it's your choice.
records.translation: 進入洞穴真的很危險。我希望不會發生意外，但為了以防萬一……今天我會一直待在這裡。#$e#身為醫生，我建議你儘量避免進入飛蛇橫行的洞穴！但最後還是由你決定。

records.source: This is fun, but I wish I had an ice cream...
records.translation: 這裡很好玩，但要是有冰淇淋就好了……

records.source: Oh, don't mind me, I'm just doing a little shopping.#$e#If I don't browse the shops, I might miss the perfect decoration for our living room!
records.translation: 噢，別管我，我只是在逛街。#$e#要是不逛逛這些商店，可能會錯過最適合我們客廳的裝飾品！

records.source: Hey, @. Enjoying the heat?
records.translation: 嘿，@。喜歡這股熱氣嗎？

records.source: I was just wondering... If I lived here, instead of Stardew Valley, would my art look different?
records.translation: 我只是在想……如果我住在這裡，而不是星露谷，創作出來的藝術會不會不一樣？

records.source: I like this place. The weather reminds me of home.
records.translation: 我喜歡這個地方。這裡的天氣讓我想起家鄉。

records.source: After a long, dark winter, this festival is a good way to revive everyone.
records.translation: 經過漫長陰暗的冬季，這場節慶正好能讓大家恢復活力。

records.source: All of this is possible because you fixed the bus, @! I can't thank you enough.
records.translation: 這一切都因為你修好了公車才得以實現，@！再怎麼感謝你也不為過。

records.source: Remember, today is the last day of the festival. We'll be back next year, though.
records.translation: 記住，今天是節慶最後一天。不過明年我們還會再來。

records.source: I hitched a ride underneath the bus.#$e#You can't find this Calico Desert flavor anywhere else. Heheh...$h
records.translation: 我搭便車躲在公車底下過來。#$e#其他地方可嚐不到這種卡利科沙漠風味。嘿嘿……$h

records.source: Hey, @. I was just thinking about milk.#$e#Would you ever try camel's milk? I've heard it's salty.
records.translation: 嘿，@。我剛才正在想牛奶的事。#$e#你會想試試駱駝奶嗎？聽說味道鹹鹹的。

records.source: I'm impressed with how well-trained these little racers are!$h
records.translation: 這些小賽手訓練得真好，讓我刮目相看！$h

records.source: Hey, kid... You takin' the day off? It's nice to kick back every once in a while, isn't it?#$e#Yep... Even ol' Pam needs some sunlight on her skin now and then! Just wake me up before I turn into leather... Heheh.
records.translation: 嘿，孩子……今天休假嗎？偶爾放鬆一下很不錯，對吧？#$e#沒錯……就連老潘姆也得偶爾曬曬太陽！在我被曬成皮革前叫醒我就好……嘿嘿。

records.source: Thousands of years ago, this place was the homeland of an ancient civilization. I wonder what they were like?
records.translation: 數千年前，這裡曾是某個古文明的家園。不知道他們是什麼樣的人？

records.source: As a shopkeeper, I find it interesting to see how other people run their shops.#$e#*whisper* Don't tell Sandy, but my grocery selection blows hers out of the water!
records.translation: 身為店主，看看別人如何經營商店很有意思。#$e#*小聲說* 別告訴珊迪，但我的雜貨種類比她強太多了！

records.source: Hey @. We're just chewing the fat over here. I don't see these guys very often, even though we're neighbors!
records.translation: 嘿，@。我們只是在這裡閒聊。明明是鄰居，我卻不常見到這些人！

records.source: Hey, @. Check out my cactus. I'm trying to think of a name for him.#$e#Hmm... maybe '%name'?
records.translation: 嘿，@。看看我的仙人掌。我正在替它想名字。#$e#嗯……叫「%name」如何？

records.source: This is probably the busiest time of the year for me! It's nice to be able to see everyone.
records.translation: 這大概是我一年中最忙碌的時候！能見到大家真好。

records.source: Hey. I'm just hanging out with this bird. She seems to like me.
records.translation: 嘿。我只是在陪這隻鳥。牠似乎很喜歡我。
